app.name: Desktop Organizer
overview.not_available.tooltip: This tool will be added in a later version.
tool.file_cleaner.title: File cleaner
tool.file_cleaner.description: Sorts a folder into subfolders by file type, with preview and undo.
tool.duplicate_finder.title: Duplicate finder
tool.duplicate_finder.description: Finds identical files by content and moves them to the Recycle Bin.
tool.file_size.title: Folder sizes
tool.file_size.description: Shows which folders use the most disk space.
tool.text_replacer.title: Text replacer
tool.text_replacer.description: Replaces terms across many files at once, with a preview of every change.
tool.backup.title: Backup
tool.backup.description: Copies chosen folders to a destination, transferring only changed files.
tool.password_generator.title: Password generator
tool.notes.title: Notes
tool.notes.description: Quick notes with tags and full-text search.
tool.tasks.title: Tasks
tool.tasks.description: Tasks with due dates, optionally linked to a reminder.
tool.reminders.title: Reminders
tool.reminders.description: One-off and recurring reminders as Windows notifications.
tool.time_tracker.title: Time tracker
tool.time_tracker.description: Track time per task or project, with daily and weekly totals.
tool.system_monitor.title: System monitor
tool.system_monitor.description: Live CPU, memory, battery and disk space.
tool.clipboard_history.title: Clipboard history
tool.clipboard_history.description: Remembers copied content, searchable and ready to copy again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.data.portable: Portable mode: data is stored in the folder next to the program file.
export.failed: The data could not be exported: {error}
delete.title: Delete all data?
delete.body: All settings, all content saved by the tools and the log files will be permanently deleted. Files in your own folders are not affected. The app closes afterwards.
delete.done: All data was deleted. The app will close now.
error.title: Unexpected error
error.body:
An unexpected error occurred: {error}

The app keeps running. Details are in the log file.
